title: Report a missing item
summary: Laravel: Report a missing item. Inspect the 404 status too.
introduction: A JSON response can include an error status. Open GET /missing.
learningObjectives: Report a missing item with Laravel

blocks.text: Create a practice Laravel project with Composer, then replace routes/web.php with one example. Start php artisan serve --host=127.0.0.1 --port=8000. These read-only starter routes need no database.

blocks.title: Report a missing item
blocks.code:
<?php
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
Route::get("/missing", fn () => response()->json(["error" => "Book not found"], 404));

blocks.text: The JSON helper receives 404 as its second argument and sends that error status.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: An error message should use an appropriate error status.
